## Pull request policy

Thank you for your interest in improving Auto Mode Gate. Pull requests are not currently reviewed
or merged.

- Report a reproducible defect through the
  [bug report form](https://github.com/Yivas/auto-mode-gate/issues/new/choose).
- Report an undisclosed vulnerability through
  [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Yivas/auto-mode-gate/security/advisories/new).

Do not include credentials, tokens, prompts, identifiers, active configuration values, or other
private data. This pull request may be closed without code review under the current
[contribution policy](https://github.com/Yivas/auto-mode-gate/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
